record.paper_title: Conformally invariant scaling limits: an overview and a collection of problems
record.original_question: Consider the Fortuin-Kasteleyn random-cluster model on Z^2 with parameter q in (0, 4), and with p chosen to be sqrt(q)/(1 + sqrt(q)), the self-dual value. With appropriate boundary conditions defining an interface, prove that the interface converges to SLE_κ, where κ = 4π / arccos(-sqrt(q)/2).

evidence.quote: Problem 2.6 ([76]). Prove that when q ∈ (0, 4) and p = √q/(1+√q), the interface of the FK model on Z2 with appropriate boundary conditions converges to SLEκ, where κ = 4 π/ cos−1(−√q/2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q\in(0,4)$ and consider the Fortuin–Kasteleyn random-cluster measure on a finite subgraph of the square lattice $\mathbb{Z}^2$ at its self-dual point $p=\sqrt{q}/(1+\sqrt{q})$. Recall that the random-cluster measure on configurations $\omega\in\{0,1\}^{E}$ is given by
$$\mu_{p,q}(\omega)\;\propto\;\prod_{e\in E} p^{\omega(e)}(1-p)^{1-\omega(e)}\;q^{k(\omega)},$$
where $k(\omega)$ is the number of connected components of the spanning subgraph determined by the open edges $\{e:\omega(e)=1\}$.

Fix a simply connected planar domain $D$ with two distinguished prime ends $a,b$ on its boundary, and approximate $D$ by subgraphs $D_\delta$ of $\delta\mathbb{Z}^2$ with two boundary arcs separated by $a_\delta,b_\delta$. Impose Dobrushin-type boundary conditions (one arc wired, the other free), so that there is a well-defined interface $\gamma_\delta$ on the medial lattice running from $a_\delta$ to $b_\delta$ between the two boundary arcs.

Prove that, as $\delta\to 0$, the law of $\gamma_\delta$ converges weakly (with respect to a suitable curve topology) to chordal Schramm–Loewner Evolution $\mathrm{SLE}_\kappa$ in $D$ from $a$ to $b$, with
$$\kappa \;=\; \frac{4\pi}{\arccos(-\sqrt{q}/2)}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The case $q=2$ (FK-Ising), giving $\kappa=16/3$, was established by Smirnov and collaborators using discrete complex analysis (parafermionic observables). For general $q\in(0,4)\setminus\{2\}$ the convergence to SLE$_\kappa$ remains open; rigorous techniques used at $q=2$ are not known to extend, although conformal invariance and rotational invariance of certain critical observables have been proven in the random-cluster model for all $q\in[1,4)$ in recent work by Duminil-Copin and collaborators.

status_evidence.title: On multiple SLE for the FK-Ising model
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence of multiple interfaces in the critical planar q=2 random cluster model... proofs rely on discrete complex analysis techniques and are beyond reach for other values of q than the FK-Ising model.
status_evidence.claim: q=2 case solved; other q open.

status_evidence.title: Configurations of FK Ising interfaces and hypergeometric SLE
